assertions.title: Monitor page with one agent renders sidebar card and main dashboard
test_names: clicking Monitor tab shows dashboard
all 4 panels render with headings
progress bar shows correct completion percentage
issue counts display open, closed, and total correctly
monitor dashboard renders with expected panels
assertions.notes: Extensively covered across monitor-dashboard.spec.ts (monitor-dashboard test id visible, 4-panel rendering, pipeline stages) and monitor-panels.spec.ts (progress bar, issue counts). journey-monitor-drilldown.spec.ts also verifies dashboard render. 15+ explicit behavioral assertions.

assertions.title: Status badge — ready (gray)
test_names: working agent shows Working status label
ready agent shows Ready status label
agent cards show correct status via data-status attribute
assertions.notes: agents-sidebar.spec.ts verifies both status text labels (Working/Ready) and data-status attributes. monitor-panels.spec.ts verifies 5 cards with data-status attributes covering all status values.

assertions.title: Agent card shows name, role, and repo badge
test_names: agent card renders status and metadata
agent card shows role label
agent cards display status text and task titles
assertions.notes: agents-sidebar.spec.ts "agent card renders status and metadata" verifies nova working card shows Working status, role "Task", and repo "loomcli". Role label test verifies Task/Plan roles. monitor-panels.spec.ts verifies task titles on cards.

assertions.title: Diff stats display (lines added/removed)
test_names: agent cards show git sync indicators (ahead/behind)
assertions.notes: Test verifies +N/-M ahead/behind sync badges (nova +2, falcon -3, ember +1/-1, jade no indicators). However, the validation assertion's actual result shows "6 changes" — the working-tree uncommitted changes count, not ahead/behind sync indicators. Missing: explicit test for the "N changes" display on agent cards with uncommitted modifications.

assertions.title: Agent card is clickable (keyboard + mouse)
test_names: agent cards have interactive attributes and keyboard support
assertions.notes: Explicitly verifies role="button", tabindex="0", focus() works on agent cards, and click triggers handler. Covers both keyboard focus and mouse click paths.

assertions.title: Agents sidebar is collapsible
test_names: toggle button collapses sidebar
toggle button expands sidebar
collapsed sidebar shows badge with agent count
assertions.notes: Three explicit tests under "sidebar collapse" describe block. Verifies data-collapsed="true"/"false" on the aside element, content visibility toggling, and the count badge showing when collapsed.

assertions.title: Workspace groups are collapsible
assertions.notes: grep for "Collapse agents", "workspace group collapse", and collapse/expand toggles within workspace groups returned zero matches in any e2e spec. The existing "sidebar collapse" tests only cover the top-level WorkspaceTree aside collapse (data-collapsed on the aside), not the per-workspace "Collapse agents" toggle button (the ›/▾ indicator that hides agent cards within a single workspace group). Needs a new test.

assertions.title: Section count badge shows total agent count
test_names: agent section shows with Agents header and count
agent summary bar shows correct counts
assertions.notes: agents-sidebar.spec.ts verifies the Agents header with count badge ("2"). monitor-panels.spec.ts "agent summary bar shows correct counts" verifies active/idle/error/sync breakdown counts (active:2, idle:2, error:1, sync:2).

assertions.title: Work queue section displays task category buttons
test_names: work queue section renders with category labels
assertions.notes: Verifies "Work Queue" heading visible plus all 6 category labels: Backlog, Open, Blocked, In Progress, Needs Review, Done.

assertions.title: Task category buttons highlight when count > 0
test_names: work queue shows correct counts from issues
assertions.notes: Verifies Open count "1" with data-highlight="true" and In Progress "1" with highlight — explicitly tests the highlight-on-nonzero behavior.

assertions.title: Work queue section is collapsible
test_names: work queue toggles expand/collapse
assertions.notes: Category labels visible when expanded and hidden when collapsed; toggle action works both directions.

assertions.title: Footer displays issue statistics
test_names: status bar shows working/reviewing/idle counts
status bar counts update with multiple working agents
assertions.notes: Verifies footer display with "1 working", "0 reviewing", "1 idle" in the first test and "2 working", "0 reviewing", "1 idle" in the second — confirms live count updates.

assertions.title: Connection banner shows 'stale data' warning when offline
test_names: stale data warning banner appears when disconnected with cached data
assertions.notes: Explicitly verifies the ConnectionBanner via role="alert", text content "Disconnected from loom server", "Last updated" timestamp, and the "Retry Now" button. Also confirms cached stale data remains visible in the agent panel.

assertions.title: Monitor page layout at 1440px (desktop)
test_names: default vertical stack at 1280x720
assertions.notes: monitor-visual-regression.spec.ts verifies desktop vertical stack layout with explicit panel visibility/heading assertions but uses viewport 1280x720 (line 531-532), not the 1440px specified in the assertion. Missing: a test pinned to 1440px viewport width.

assertions.title: Monitor page layout at 1024px (tablet)
assertions.notes: Explicitly SKIPPED via test.describe.skip("responsive layout at 1024px") at line 573 of monitor-visual-regression.spec.ts. Skipped tests do not count as coverage per the audit rules. The skip reason is that NavRail does not expose the Monitor button below desktop widths.

assertions.title: Monitor page layout at 768px (mobile)
assertions.notes: Explicitly SKIPPED via test.describe.skip("responsive layout at 768px") at line 609 of monitor-visual-regression.spec.ts. Same skip reason as MON-051 — NavRail does not expose the Monitor button at mobile widths.

assertions.title: Tab navigates through sidebar toggles and buttons
test_names: Skip link is first focusable element
CreateIssueModal: Tab cycles within modal fields
Shift+Tab wraps from first to last element in modal
assertions.notes: keyboard-focus-management.spec.ts verifies Tab cycling inside CreateIssueModal and the WorkspaceSwitcher. keyboard-global-shortcuts.spec.ts covers number keys / ? / Cmd+K. But NO test specifically exercises Tab sequentially through sidebar collapse toggle → workspace entries → agent cards → work queue toggle → category buttons to verify the sidebar's interactive-element tab order.

assertions.title: Tab navigates through agent cards
test_names: agent cards have interactive attributes and keyboard support
assertions.notes: monitor-panels.spec.ts verifies agent cards have tabindex="0" (so they ARE in the tab order) and focus() programmatically works. keyboard-focus-management.spec.ts covers Tab inside modals. However, no test explicitly presses Tab to walk focus from one agent card to the next across multiple cards in the monitor panel.

assertions.title: Enter/Space activates card click handler
test_names: agent cards have interactive attributes and keyboard support
assertions.notes: Cards use role="button" + tabindex="0" + click handler — native button semantics guarantee Enter/Space activation. Test verifies role, tabindex, focus, and click. HTMLButtonElement activation via Enter/Space is a platform guarantee when role="button" is set on a focusable element with click handling.

assertions.title: Missing optional fields render gracefully
test_names: renders with empty agent data
empty agents shows No agents found message
all panels show empty state messages when no data
no agent section when loom unavailable and no config agents
assertions.notes: Extensively covered across empty/degraded states: "No agents found" text, empty state messages across all 4 panels, "No blocking dependencies" checkmark, and sidebar hiding the agent section when there are no agents at all.

assertions.title: Agent card is keyboard accessible
test_names: agent cards have interactive attributes and keyboard support
Step 1-3: Open agent panel and verify Info tab
assertions.notes: monitor-panels.spec.ts verifies role="button", tabindex="0", focusability, and click. agent-review-journey.spec.ts drives the full panel navigation (Info, Git, Diff, Files tabs) demonstrating end-to-end keyboard-actionable card behavior.

assertions.title: Clicking agent card in sidebar opens detail panel
test_names: Step 1-3: Open agent panel and verify Info tab
Click bottleneck issue to open detail panel
clicking agent opens AgentDetailPanel
assertions.notes: agent-review-journey.spec.ts verifies panel open (data-state="open", h2 contains agent name) plus close via X button and Escape. journey-monitor-drilldown.spec.ts covers bottleneck click opening detail panel. multi-workspace-monitoring.spec.ts covers the workspace-switch → click-agent → panel-open flow.

assertions.title: Dark-mode assertions verify theme attribute before contrast checks
assertions.notes: Search across all 12 monitor-related e2e specs for "dark", "theme", "data-theme", and "contrast" returned zero matches. The only dark-text/contrast test in the entire e2e suite is kanban-redesign.spec.ts "P2 badge has dark text (WCAG contrast)" — unrelated to monitor view and does not toggle a theme attribute. No existing test sets document.documentElement.dataset.theme to "dark" or verifies contrast-sensitive monitor elements in dark mode.
